_note: Defender for Cloud Apps (CASB) policies are configured via its own REST API or admin portal, not ARM/Bicep or Exchange PowerShell — a third distinct deployment surface in this same phase, which is itself worth being able to explain: three different Microsoft security products, three different configuration planes (ARM, Exchange PowerShell, Cloud Apps API), because they have different architectural heritages within Microsoft's portfolio.
description: Tunes CASB's built-in impossible-travel and mass-download anomaly models — the CASB-side counterpart to this project's identity-lateral-movement-enriched.kql Sentinel detection, watching SaaS app usage specifically (Dropbox, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Box) rather than Azure AD sign-ins.

massDownload.custom_note: Same threshold reasoning as the mass-file-exfiltration detection in this profile's Sentinel-Detection-Response-Pack, applied here to SaaS apps instead of SharePoint/OneDrive

governanceAction.onMediumConfidence: Alert only, route to analyst queue
